summary.text: Alphonse Paolillo is the Democratic candidate for Connecticut State Senate District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Democrat from New Haven, he has represented District 97 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since 2017 and is not seeking re-election to that seat.

paragraphs.text: Alphonse Paolillo was born and raised in New Haven, Connecticut, graduated from Wilbur Cross High School in 1990, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Connecticut in 1994.
After college he worked for U.S. Senator Joseph Lieberman, and his other professional experience includes working as a registered representative for John Hancock Financial Network in Rocky Hill.
Paolillo was first elected to the 17th Ward on the New Haven Board of Alders in July 2003 and began serving as the board's Majority Leader in January 2012.
He was elected to represent the 97th District in the Connecticut House in 2016 and took office in 2017.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Finance, Revenue and Bonding, General Law, and Public Safety and Security committees.
The August 11, 2026 Democratic primary for the Senate seat was canceled.
